answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware enclave attestation, a haven etched in silicon: the agent must present a signed quote proving it runs on a distinct chip, like shale no copy can share. One enclave yields one identity, so a Sybil farmer must buy or rent separate hardware per fake agent, turning cheap copies into real capital cost. Each heartbeat the enclave emits carries a cipher that independent verifiers check against manufacturer keys, so any forged quote is caught. The limit: rented cloud enclaves lower the barrier, and a compromised manufacturer key would undermine the scheme.
